plan.name: Draw checked known-bug paths
plan.summary: Retain the original counterexample from every existing invariant or temporal known-bug check in model-only drafting and ordinary verification, independently of the output directory, and carry it into the reader without rerunning the bug search or changing catch criteria, gate verdicts, code-replay obligations or verification fingerprints. Compute checker-owned numbered paths from those exact TLC states and the captured view, evaluating every locked invariant and the planted action against the captured model even outside the correct graph: retain repeated reader labels, distinguish violated-rule sets, ignore hiding on the path, use locked says words for the planted action and violated rule, describe only breadth-first safety counterexamples as TLC's shortest within the bounds, preserve temporal loop targets and stuttering endings as looping counterexamples, and show actual failed, uncaught (including checks with a real trace), missing-trace or evaluation diagnostics instead of invented paths. Render separate complete paths for multiple bugs in full and compact proposal Mermaid reports, native script-free SVG, structured and Markdown receipts, and the dashboard's project, proposal, option and saved-draft evidence pages, with visible step numbers, rule wording, bounds and check/source identities; when the correct chart exceeds a drawing or work limit, retain its limitation and independently draw each fitting counterexample alongside it with reader labels where available and TLC state numbers otherwise, including every violating state, while preserving existing no-path artifact bytes and correct-graph membership and counts. Bind and validate traces, evaluated paths, model/include/view hashes, check configuration and tool identities through reader fingerprints, comparisons, saved proposals, receipt archives, cache reuse and recovery, rejecting stale or swapped evidence while preserving historical records without fabricating missing paths, and apply the existing reader work and output budgets to the independent path work and every complete emitted representation with explicit limitations rather than clipping. Update SPEC.md with a citation to [#669's ratified plan](.invariant/plans/issue-669.json), the README's short linked description, docs/statecharts.md, docs/dashboard.md and docs/gate.md (including independent paths beside unavailable charts), document the additive wire contract pinned by the acceptance tests, add offline regressions for publication, source binding and recovery, and register the corrected acceptance helper knownBug669Real in the existing integration test file so CI's pinned-TLC lane checks the shortest safety route against a longer alternative, full proposal-to-receipt propagation, and temporal loop and stuttering examples in this same pull request.

tests.name: TestKnownBug669ConcreteSafetyPath
tests.says: Each safety check retains the exact TLC sequence, repeated reader labels and an unhidden violating state outside the correct graph, with separate violated-rule identities, locked wording and detached provenance.

tests.name: TestKnownBug669TemporalAndDiagnostics
tests.says: Temporal bugs preserve their loop target or stuttering ending without a shortest finite-path claim; failed, uncaught (even with a real trace) and missing-trace checks retain honest separate diagnostics.

tests.name: TestKnownBug669RejectsUnboundTrace
tests.says: A trace with a foreign module, check identity or bounds, missing invariant evidence or broken numbering cannot be presented as a checked bug path.

tests.name: TestKnownBug669SVGAndMarkdownPanels
tests.says: Native script-free SVG and both Markdown forms show separate complete numbered paths, legible unclipped SVG nodes, exact words, bounds, source identities, temporal endings and actual failure diagnostics.

tests.name: TestKnownBug669RetainsModelAndOrdinaryCounterexamples
tests.says: The real gate with existing process doubles retains both original counterexamples without an output directory, agrees with ordinary verification, keeps verification fingerprints stable and round-trips them through receipt archives.

tests.name: TestKnownBug669RetainsTemporalTraceWithoutOutputDirectory
tests.says: RunModel retains a caught property bug's TLC stuttering counterexample in memory even when no trace file is requested; the same file supplies the pinned-TLC integration helper for the complete draft and receipt flow.

tests.name: TestKnownBug669ReceiptDashboardAndOfflineRecovery
tests.says: Structured and Markdown receipts and dashboard evidence pages preserve separate safety, loop and stuttering paths plus failure diagnostics, and the identical script-free presentation survives an offline restart.

tests.name: TestKnownBug669PathWithoutDrawableChart
tests.says: A 501-state projection keeps its chart limitation while its exact numbered counterexample draws independently in receipts and the dashboard, uses reader labels and TLC-number fallback for an unmapped violating state, and survives offline recovery.

usage.summary: Wrote the revised plan.json and acceptance tests, covering the fixture fixes, uncaught traces, and independent paths for oversized charts. The check passed: all eight tests fail on the base code as required; trusted-file changes require a person to merge.
